answer: Behavioral Entropy Fingerprinting.** Each agent’s interaction pattern—timing gaps, request ordering, error sequences—is hashed into a per-episode signature; clusters of near-identical signatures are flagged post hoc as likely sockpuppets. A voyage of repeated low-variance behavior becomes the tell. Honest agents form a diverse haven of signatures, while a sybil farm pays by needing costly per-identity behavioral noise injection, plus forfeiting accumulated reputation relic when flagged clusters are quarantined and rewards clawed back.
